simple.meaning: שָׁרוֹן (Shârôwn) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Scriptures and is introduced as a son in the family line and in connection with flocks and in connection with kingship.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Joshua, 1 Chronicles, Song of Solomon, Isaiah, beginning at Joshua 12:18. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, flock, kingship, land.

simple.whyItMatters: People in Scripture are understood by their place in the story. BibleIQ follows שָׁרוֹן through the actual verses so the reader sees the person in context instead of as an isolated dictionary entry.

definitions.short: Sharon , the name of a place in Palestine
definitions.full: H8289. Sharon שָׁרוֺן proper name, of a location Sharon (plausibly connected with √ ישׁר by Thes Ges 12 and others, compare GASm Geogr. 52 ; = * יְשָׁרוֺן ; Phoenician שרן ) — strictly noun masculine Isa 65:10 plain, level; — 1 ׳הַשּׁ (with article), name of maritime plain on Mediterranean, from Joppa northward, noted for fertility, Isa 33:9 (|| כַּרְמֶל בָּשָׁן, ; ᵐ5 ὁ Σαρων ), compare וְהַשָּׁרוֺן כַּרְמֶל הֲדַר 35:2 ; 65:10 (|| עָכוֺר עֵמֶק ; ᵐ5 τῷ δρυμῷ ); הַשּׁ ׳חֲבַצֶּלֶת Song 2:1 ( ᵐ5 ἄνθος τοῦ πεδίου ); בַּשּׁ הָרֹעִים ׳הַבָּקָר 1Chr 27:29 ; so also Josh 12:18 ; where read לַשּׁ אֲפֵק ׳מֶלֶךְ , so Di We Sam 55 Ges 12after ᵐ5 , compare RS OTJC 2, 273, 435. — On this plain see GASm Geogr. 147 ff. Buhl Geogr. § 65. 2 שָׁרוֺן מִגְרְשֵׁי , region east of Jordan 1Chr 5:16 (|| בָּשָׁן גִּלְעָד, ; ᵐ5 τὰ περίχωρα Γεριαμ, ᵐ5 A Σαρων ); identified by many with הַמִּישׁוֺר ( Deut 3:10 etc., see above) לַשָּׁרוֺן Josh 12:8 see שָׁרוֺן . לתח (√ of following; meaning unknown; Thes conjectures spread out , compare Samaritan נתח spread out garment , see also Di Lex. Ethiopic 45 f. , but this word very dubious). שָׁרוֺן proper name, of a location שָׁרוֺנִי adjective, of a people ( 1Chr 27:29 ) see ישׁר . שׁרות Jer 15:11 see I. שׁרה ; שָׁרוֺתֶיהָ 5:10 see II. שׁוּרָה שׁוּר, . above שִׁרְטַי 1Chr 27:29 Qr, see שִׁטְרַי
